articles.summary: After market close on December 1, 2026, NetApp (NASDAQ: NTAP) will announce financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, which ended October 30, 2026. NetApp executive management will host a conference call Webcast at 2:30 p.m. Pacific Time to discuss these results and provide their perspective on market dynamics. How to Participate The live Webcast call can be accessed at investors.netapp.com . Please allow at least 15 minutes prior to the start of the Webcast to log in. An audio replay Webcast will also be available after 4:30 p.m. Pacific Time. articles.summary: Neocloud pioneer selects the fastest storage on the planet, NetApp Novus, architected to enable its file system to grow to support zettabyte-scale AI factory operations NetApp® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, today announced that Nebul, a European AI-native cloud provider, is the first neocloud to adopt NetApp Novus™, its new high-performance architecture designed to deliver the fastest storage on the planet. Nebul is building the Intelligent Cloud, a sovereign platform integrating accelerated infrastructure, enterprise data services and production AI capabilities. Novus, now generally available, is designed to maximize utilization for millions of GPUs and is architected for up to 100 TB per second of aggregate throughput. Moving quickly to adopt the groundbreaking technology, Nebul and NetApp are exploring new opportunities to help organizations achieve AI-powered advantage and unlock greater value from their data. articles.summary: Acquisition strengthens NetApp Novus, high-performance storage, with differentiated metadata technology and a parallel file architecture purpose-built for AI NetApp® (NASDAQ: NTAP), the Intelligent Data Infrastructure company, today announced that it completed the acquisition of PEAK:AIO, a pioneer in next-generation metadata architecture and high-performance parallel file systems. With this acquisition, NetApp can leverage metadata services and parallel namespace innovations to power the fastest storage on the planet, NetApp Novus, to support zettabyte-scale file systems for the most demanding workloads of AI clouds and GPU-as-a-service providers. For the best AI infrastructure economics, organizations need to keep GPU resources continuously supplied with data without bottlenecks.
